grades: Second or third year of high school (rising juniors and seniors)
name: Summer Ventures in Science and Mathematics
org: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics (NCSSM), state funded
city: Appalachian State, East Carolina, UNC Charlotte and UNC Wilmington campuses, NC
what_you_do: Live on a UNC system campus for about four weeks. You do a hands-on STEM research project with faculty. You often work in a small team. Recent topics include ecology, biochemistry, DNA analysis and cybersecurity.
who_can_apply: Academically talented North Carolina students in their second or third year of high school who want STEM careers. Applicants must complete the Residency Determination Service process. Students are picked by Congressional District.
pay_detail: No cost to accepted students. Meals and housing on campus are included. It does not pay a wage.
duration: About four weeks between mid-June and end of July 2027, depending on the campus
deadline_text: Application opens Oct 15, 2026 at cfnc.org. Essays are due Jan 5, 2027. Transcripts and teacher and counselor forms are due Feb 28, 2027. Decisions come Apr 2, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply through NCSSM Admissions. The application is on cfnc.org. Finish the Residency Determination Service step. Write the essays. Have your school send your transcript and teacher and counselor evaluations.
notes: 2027 campuses and dates listed: Appalachian State (June 20 to July 31, to be decided), East Carolina (virtual week June 27 to July 3, then on campus July 4 to 24), UNC Charlotte (June 20 to July 31, to be decided), UNC Wilmington (June 20 to July 17). Accepted students do an online Research Prep course in June. Contact: summerventures@ncssm.edu or 919-416-2747.
